findings.title: Stored XSS in name parameter reveals CTF flag
findings.description: The name parameter on /page is vulnerable to XSS. Injecting an img tag with onerror handler triggers JavaScript execution and reveals the flag.

reproduction.expected: XSS alert with 'XSS' string executes, flag is revealed in response
